payload.body:
examiner (round 1): writing tests/state-exams/two-pages-converge.test.ts as the registered convergence exam plus one bun:test block per Proof leg.

Plan, leg by leg:
- (a) [M1] the spec is a module-level const SPEC passed to convergenceExam(SPEC) — that is the only way leg (a)'s 'read back in-process' can be honoured — and one test asserts each field of M1 by equality (server 'server', entry 'client/index.html', module 'todos', the two actions, the expected path, the two views, the mutant), plus that the second view is the attr form on #todo-0 and carries no 'text' key at all. The first Run: line (the sed/tr/grep window over client/src/TodoItem.tsx) is run verbatim in the same test, so M1's premise that #todo-0 carries the todo's words as its accessible name is pinned here and fails on any markup that moves the id or the label off that element.
- (b) [M2] the expected file parses to M2's literal exactly, and its rows 1 and 2 equal the seed's rows 1 and 2 read from state-exams/seeds/default-todos.json; the 'Learn TinyBase' grep and 'git diff --quiet $ULTRA_BASE -- state-exams' are run verbatim.
- (c) [M3] the registration itself, plus runConvergenceExam(SPEC) in-process with ULTRA_RUN_DIR pointed at a temp dir (ok true, walls.json with numeric sync_ms/converge_ms, transitions.json an array of >= 2), and the same spec with expected = state-exams/expected/one-open-todo.json resolving ok false with a failure beginning 'convergence: '.
- (d) [M4] the fifth and sixth Run: lines verbatim against README.md and AGENTS.md — the only legs red at BASE.

One reading recorded here rather than left to be reconstructed: the exam does NOT shell out to 'bun run lint:state' (M2's second sentence). A verification never re-runs the linter — that is the Proof's own second Run: line, executed by the driver, and the rest of M2 is asserted in-process here. Everything else M2 names is covered by assertion.

Second reading: the spec names no 'assets'. M1 lists the keys and assets is not among them, and it is also the stronger exam — all three pages share one loopback origin, so serving /sqlite3.wasm would let page C reach the state out of shared kvvfs storage instead of out of the sync, which is the very thing leg (c) claims. 'clock' is spelled because ConvergenceExamSpec requires it.

payload.body:
Verified leg (c) against a scratch registration (written, run, deleted — `tests/state-exams/two-pages-converge.test.ts` stays clear for the peer's exam), and found one thing M1's field list omits.

M1 enumerates `server`, `entry`, `module`, the two actions, `expected`, the two views and the mutant. Registered with exactly those, the exam is **red**:

    act: no element matches role=textbox name="New todo"

The convergence page is unseeded and unflagged, so `StoreLinks` mounts `useCreatePersister` and `getDb()` fetches `/sqlite3.wasm`. `serveExam` answers the page HTML for every path `assets` does not name, so the wasm init never resolves, `onReady` never fires, and `client/src/App.tsx` is still painting `<div id="loading">` when `act` runs. `walls.json` from that run: `store_ms` 212, `render` `skipped`, `action_ms` null — `__TINYAPP_STORE__` is handed out at store creation, well before the list renders, so `waitStore` is not the wait that was missing.

The registration needs the same `assets` line `tests/state-exams/added-todo-survives-reload.test.ts` already carries for the same page:

    assets: {'/sqlite3.wasm': 'node_modules/@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm/dist/sqlite3.wasm'},

plus `clock` (required on `ConvergenceExamSpec`, also unnamed by M1; I used `'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'`). With those two beside M1's fields the exam is green: `sync_ms` 86.8, `converge_ms` 70.6, `transitions.json` 3 entries, `rows.json` and `stores.json` written, mutant killed. So leg (c) is satisfiable — M1's list is not exhaustive, not wrong — but a registration written from M1's words alone will be red on the first run. Flagged as a plan-defect disclosure, not a park.

M1's premise needed no app edit: `client/src/TodoItem.tsx` at BASE already renders `<Checkbox render={<span id={\`todo-\${rowId}\`} />} aria-label={todo.text} …/>`, and the first Run line's `/id={.todo-/,/^ *\/>/` window closes on that element's own `/>`. M2 is a no-touch: `state-exams/expected/default-todos-plus-buy-milk.json` is already the persistence exam's expected state; `git diff --quiet $ULTRA_BASE -- state-exams` is clean and `bun run lint:state` is 0 findings over 26 snapshots and 29 exams. My diff is AGENTS.md and README.md only.

payload.body:
examiner (round 1), done: tests/state-exams/two-pages-converge.test.ts is on the tree. At BASE it is 8 pass / 2 fail, and the two failures are leg (d) alone — the README and AGENTS sentences M4 asks for, which do not exist yet. Everything else is green at BASE, including the registered 'convergence exam: two-pages-converge' itself.

One correction to my approach comment above, measured rather than reasoned. I had said the spec would name no 'assets'. It has to. client/index.html opened unseeded and unflagged mounts its SQLite persister, and App renders '#loading' until that persister has loaded; with /sqlite3.wasm unserved the exam's own origin answers the page's HTML for that path, getDb() never resolves, and the document stays the spinner. The first run failed as:

    convergence: act: no element matches role=textbox name="New todo"

and a probe over one page confirmed the DOM is '<div id="loading" class="... animate-spin ...">' and nothing else in #app. So the spec carries
{'/sqlite3.wasm': 'node_modules/@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm/dist/sqlite3.wasm'} — the same map tests/state-exams/added-todo-survives-reload.test.ts already uses on this same entry. M1 lists the keys the spec names and does not forbid the two the type or the page require ('clock' and 'assets'); leg (a) reads both back, so the reason is on the record rather than buried. The cost of it is worth writing down for a later reader: all three pages share one loopback origin, so they share one kvvfs database, and page C can in principle reach the state out of that shared storage as well as out of the sync. B's agreement is unaffected — B is open before the action and only its synchronizer can bring it the new row — and the module object's own content and rows are the reading no page could have faked. There is no way to give C an origin of its own from the spec; serveExam serves one origin per run.

The other reading, unchanged: the exam does not shell out to 'bun run lint:state'. A verification proves its claim through imports and calls and does not re-run the linter — that command is the Proof's own second Run: line, executed by the driver, so nothing about M2 goes unproven. Leg (b) asserts in-process that the expected file parses to M2's literal exactly, that its rows 1 and 2 are the seed's rows 1 and 2 read from state-exams/seeds/default-todos.json, that row 0 is the only row added, and it runs the third and fourth Run: lines verbatim — the fourth being 'git diff --quiet $ULTRA_BASE -- state-exams', with $ULTRA_BASE falling back to 7be55c13db331973f1d1b79936b9f03c6ac4360f when the driver has not set it, so the line means the same thing run by hand.

Leg (c) is three whole convergence runs: the registration, one runConvergenceExam(SPEC) with ULTRA_RUN_DIR pointed at a temp dir (ok true, walls.json carrying numeric sync_ms and converge_ms, transitions.json an array of at least 2), and the same spec with expected = state-exams/expected/one-open-todo.json resolving ok false with a failure beginning 'convergence: '. All three are green on this machine; the whole file runs in about 11 s.

Leg (d) was checked satisfiable and then reverted: with a celld/CELLD_BIN/TINYAPP_BROWSER paragraph added under README's '## State exams' and AGENTS' 'Open the same room URL in two clients' sentence replaced by one naming the convergence exam, both Run: lines exit 0 and the file goes 10/10. README.md and AGENTS.md are back at BASE — the implementer's two edits are the whole of what is left.
